LanguageData.TM_EtherGateSummonDesc: Spend 100 magofuel to summon a hauling servant for one day. No food, sleep or air required. Also mines with a starting Mining skill of 10 and builds with a starting Construction skill of 5. Work priority: construction, designated mining, then hauling.
LanguageData.TM_EtherGateUnavailable: The ether gate must be placed on a map, owned by your faction and switched on.
LanguageData.TM_EtherGateNoLanding: No safe space beside the gate for a servant.
LanguageData.TM_EtherGateFailed: Summoning failed. No magofuel was consumed.
